newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kawasaki Steel to set up ferrite JV in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki Steel to set up ferrite JV in Thailand.

text.p: Kawasaki Steel Corp said on Monday that it and a wholly owned subsidiary would jointly set up a firm in Thailand in November to produce and market soft ferrite products.

The two companies will invest a total of around 2.2 billion yen in the new joint venture, Kawatetsu Ferrite (Thailand) Co Ltd, in Rayong province, southeast of Bangkok, Kawasaki Steel said in a statement.
The new firm, with an annual production capacity of 2,400 tonnes, is expected to start operations in January 1998, the statement said.

A spokesman for Kawasaki Steel said that the move was in reponse to growing demand from local firms owned by Japanese companies that make transformers used in products like personal computers and home appliances.
The name of the wholly owned subsidiary involved in the venture is Kawatetsu Ferrite Corp.
